entities.name: Janko Vukotić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Janko Vukotić was a Montenegrin serdar who served in the militaries Montenegro and the Kingdom of Yugoslavia. He led the Kingdom of Montenegro's military during World War I and was interned as a prisoner of war after the country surrendered.
